name: Joed
title: Benjaminite clan leader in Jerusalem
summary: Joed was a Benjaminite mentioned in Nehemiah's genealogy of those who settled in Jerusalem after returning from the Babylonian exile. He was the son of Pedaiah and the father of Meshullam, belonging to the group that helped repopulate the holy city. His role was connected to the rebuilding of the Jewish community in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Nehemiah's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Joed is mentioned as part of the lineage of the Benjaminites who settled in Jerusalem after the exile. He is listed as the son of Pedaiah in the lineage of Sallu.

keyEvents.title: Repopulation of Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: After returning from Babylon, there was a need to repopulate Jerusalem. Leaders from various tribes, including Benjaminites like Joed's family, settled in the city.

keyEvents.title: Settlement of the Benjaminites
keyEvents.description: The Benjaminites formed an important part of those who settled in Jerusalem. Joed's lineage was among those who helped rebuild the community in the city.

keyEvents.title: Parallel Genealogical Record in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: The genealogies of those who lived in Jerusalem after the exile are also found in 1 Chronicles, where similar Benjaminite family lines are recorded.
